msg.fpvdrones.no_strike_drone: No active UAV for this tablet

tooltip.fpvdrones.goggles: Wear them to see the drone your controller is bound to.
tooltip.fpvdrones.drone_remote: Shift+RMB a drone to bind. Watch through FPV goggles.
tooltip.fpvdrones.fpv: Payload: PG-7VS, OG-7 or 5L canister. Impact = boom.
tooltip.fpvdrones.mavic: Recon and drops: up to 2x RGD-5 / VOG-17M. Drop with [G].
tooltip.fpvdrones.strike: Load it into a launcher or a launch truck.
tooltip.fpvdrones.truck: RMB to drive, RMB with a UAV to load, Shift+RMB for menu. [G] in the cab opens the menu.
tooltip.fpvdrones.tablet: RMB a launcher/truck or Shift+RMB a flying UAV to bind. RMB to watch.
tooltip.fpvdrones.remote: RMB a launcher/truck to bind. RMB in air to fire. Shift+RMB for status.
tooltip.fpvdrones.launch_pad: RMB it with a drone to put the drone on the pad.
death.attack.fpvdrones.shrapnel.player: %1$s was shredded by shrapnel while fleeing %2$s
death.attack.fpvdrones.cumulative: %1$s was burned through by a shaped charge
death.attack.fpvdrones.cumulative.player: %1$s was burned through by a shaped charge while fleeing %2$s
death.attack.fpvdrones.cumulative_by: %1$s was burned through by %2$s's shaped charge
death.attack.fpvdrones.cumulative_by.ite: %1$s was burned through by %2$s's shaped charge
tooltip.fpvdrones.radar: Search radar on a mast: sees Shaheds, Gerans, aircraft and missiles out to 2000 blocks, FPVs and Mavics to 230 (worse close to the ground). Feeds your side's radar consoles within 4000 blocks. RMB switches it on and off.
tooltip.fpvdrones.radar_console: The radar's computer: the air picture from all your radars. Pick a contact and press Intercept: the nearest ready interceptor takes off. RMB to open.
tooltip.fpvdrones.interceptor: P1-SUN style interceptor: 290 km/h, leads its target by itself and bursts next to it. Put it on the ground and it waits for the interceptor remote or a radar console. Stays up 3 minutes. RMB a parked one to pick it up.
tooltip.fpvdrones.interceptor_remote: Spotted a drone? Put the sight on it and RMB: the nearest ready interceptor goes after it. Shift+RMB: how many are ready.
msg.fpvdrones.intercept_sent: Interceptor away, %s m to the target
msg.fpvdrones.intercept_none: No ready interceptor near the target
msg.fpvdrones.intercept_no_target: No target: put the sight on a drone
msg.fpvdrones.rc_unbound: Controller not bound - Shift+RMB a Mavic
msg.fpvdrones.rc_mavic_only: This controller only works with a Mavic
msg.fpvdrones.rth_battery: Battery at 20%% - Mavic is flying home. Point saved: %s
msg.fpvdrones.rth_landed: Mavic landed at the home point
msg.fpvdrones.beacon_landed: Beacon #%s landed at %s - the code is in the launcher menu
msg.fpvdrones.adgun_auto_on: Auto: engaging hostile drones, Shaheds and ATGMs
msg.fpvdrones.adgun_all_on: Auto: engaging EVERYTHING in the air, friendly drones too
msg.fpvdrones.no_lock: No lock - keep the target in the box
tooltip.fpvdrones.mavic_remote: Shift+RMB a Mavic to bind. RMB to fly, no goggles needed.
tooltip.fpvdrones.radio_beacon: Hangs under a Mavic. Shaheds/Gerans home on wherever it lands.
tooltip.fpvdrones.air_defense_gun: Anti-drone gun system: radar, TV/IR sight, rounds burst at the computed point, out to 450 blocks. RMB to take the sight, LMB fires. [G] or Shift+RMB cycles: manual / auto vs hostiles / auto vs everything airborne.
tooltip.fpvdrones.kornet: RMB to sit. Hold RMB to look through the sight, LMB to launch. Keep the crosshair on target until impact.
tooltip.fpvdrones.ew_truck: Mobile jammer: other people's FPVs and Mavics may lose their link, Shaheds get their satellite navigation spoofed, within 160 blocks. RMB to drive, Shift+RMB switches it on and off.
tooltip.fpvdrones.ew_station: Fixed jammer: like the Ural but 240 blocks around. RMB switches it on and off. Leaves your own drones alone.
tooltip.fpvdrones.relay: Optional relay for Shaheds and Gerans: targets can be set past their normal range (another 12000 blocks from the relay, relays chain up), and under it a jammer hardly leads them astray. RMB switches it on and off.
tooltip.fpvdrones.javelin: Hold RMB to aim, keep the target boxed until lock, LMB to launch.
tooltip.fpvdrones.ammo_30mm: For the ZAK-30 Tsitadel: rounds with programmable airburst fuses.
tooltip.fpvdrones.kornet_missile: For the Kornet. Spares in your inventory reload automatically.
death.attack.fpvdrones.shell: %1$s was blown apart by a 30 mm shell
death.attack.fpvdrones.shell.player: %1$s was blown apart by a 30 mm shell while fleeing %2$s
death.attack.fpvdrones.shell_by: %1$s was blown apart by %2$s's 30 mm shell
death.attack.fpvdrones.shell_by.item: %1$s was blown apart by %2$s's 30 mm shell
